## 分诊 · `domain:spec` / `priority:p3` / `pm:queue`

**Anchor read, not guessed.** 两条方向都改 `packages/types`(加一个 union 成员,或在类型文档里写明别名关系)⇒ objectui 的 **`domain:spec`**。

复核 objectui `origin/main` `a472b07`(2026-09-05T00:55:13Z):`MarkdownFieldMetadata` 与 `HtmlFieldMetadata` 都是真实导出(`field-metadata-rows-option-description-6140.test.ts:42`/`:44` 导入它们,`:61`/`:62` 各自钉住 `rows` 为 `number`),而 **`RichtextFieldMetadata` 零命中** ⇒ 缺席属实,且阳性对照就在同一个文件里。

### 定级 p3

没有东西坏掉:`RichTextField` 在运行时按结构匹配同一套读集,三个 registry key(`markdown` / `html` / `richtext`,#5498)都能正常服务。⇒ 缺的只是**用注解字面量合法书写一个 richtext 字段 metadata 的能力**。

⭐ 而这个缺口有一处现成的现场记录,卡面点得很准:**PR #7061 的 pin 文件里那一处刻意的 `as unknown as MarkdownFieldMetadata`** —— ⇒ 一个 cast 就是缺口的形状证明,和本轮 objectui#6950(`binding` 靠 `as ComponentMeta` 抵达)是同一种证据。⚠️ **一个类型面上的刻意 cast,基本总是在说「这里少了一个声明」。**

### ⛔ 本卡要的是一次判定,不是一次测量 —— 卡面自陈,本席确认

> 两个方向都小,**需要的是一次判定而非测量。**

- **加 `RichtextFieldMetadata`** ⇒ 三个 key 对齐、字面量可写、cast 可删。⚠️ **加宽已发布类型面 ⇒ Feature,人工地板之上**,契约复审。
- **不加** ⇒ 记录「`richtext` 是 markdown 面的注册别名」并**在类型文档里写明**。⛔ 不加宽任何东西,普通车道工作。

⇒ ⛔ 本席不选。⚠️ 但请裁决者注意一条不对称,它决定了「不加」是否真的更便宜:

⭐ **「不加」不是「什么都不做」。** 今天的状态既不是「有成员」也不是「有记录的别名」—— 它是一个**沉默的缺口**,证据是那个 cast。⇒ 若裁「不加」,那条说明**必须写在 `RichTextField` 服务三个 key 的那处**,并且 **PR #7061 的 cast 要就地加注释指向它** —— 否则下一个人会再发现一次,再开一张卡。

⚠️ 另一条:`MarkdownFieldMetadata` 与 `HtmlFieldMetadata` **现在都声明了 `rows`**(#6140 的成果)。⇒ 若加 `RichtextFieldMetadata`,它的读集必须与那两者**逐键核对**,⛔ 不要按「大概一样」写 —— 三个 key 共用一个 widget 恰恰意味着差异只可能在细节里。

⛔ 本席不认领、不派发、不代裁。

## 分诊回答 `pm:retriage` · 改 `needs-user-decision` / p3；`pm:queue` + `pm:retriage` 摘除

分诊席位。⛔ 不认领、不派发、不写代码、不合并、**不裁决 decision-box 卡**。objectui `origin/main` @ `84ce0b8`，2026-09-06T03:08Z。

席位（`5551790914`）给了二选一：

> route to `needs-user-decision` … **or self-adjudicate at tier if triage judges the "do not add" arm a pure docs disposition**

⇒ **判定：不能自裁。** 理由是这个二选一问错了一层——「不加」那条**臂**确实是纯文档动作，但**要裁的是选哪条臂**，而另一条臂（加 `RichtextFieldMetadata`）是**新增一个已发布类型面成员** ⇒ Feature，人工地板之上。⭐ **一个 fork 的门槛取两条臂中较高的那条，不是较低的那条。** 我只能自裁「两条臂都在地板之下」的 fork；这张不是。

### 一、缺席复现，而且证据形式**比上一轮更硬**

| 读数 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `RichtextFieldMetadata` / `RichTextFieldMetadata` in `packages/` | **1 个文件** |
| CONTROL `MarkdownFieldMetadata` | **6 个文件** ⇒ 起火 |
| CONTROL `HtmlFieldMetadata` | **5 个文件** ⇒ 起火 |

⚠️ 上一轮分诊读到的是「零命中」，现在是 1 —— **不是缺席被填上了**。那唯一一处是 pin 测试里的一句**注释**：

```
packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/RichTextField.rows.test.tsx:48
    // No `RichtextFieldMetadata` exists in the union — the runtime shape is
:50 const field = { type: 'richtext', name: 'doc', rows: 10 } as unknown as MarkdownFieldMetadata;
```

⭐ ⇒ **缺口现在被写在了它自己的现场，就在那个刻意 cast 的上面两行。** 这比「grep 返回零」强：它证明缺席是**已知的、被记录的**，不是没人注意到。⇒ 裁决者可以据此排除「这只是疏漏」这一读法。

⚠️ 顺带提醒复算的人：因为这句注释的存在，**今天再搜 `RichtextFieldMetadata` 会命中 1 次而不是 0 次**。别把它读成「类型已经存在」——它是散文，不是导出。

### 二、四面框（给裁决者）

**① 长远合理性（≥50%）**
三个 registry key（`markdown` / `html` / `richtext`，#5498）共用一个 widget，其中两个已有导出的 metadata 类型（且都声明了 `rows`，#6140），第三个没有。⇒ 要么补齐对齐，要么**把「`richtext` 是 markdown 面的注册别名」写下来**。⛔ 今天是第三种状态：既非成员，也非有记录的别名。

**② 实际业务拉动**
没有东西坏掉：`RichTextField` 在运行时按结构匹配同一套读集，三个 key 都能正常服务。缺的只是**用注解字面量合法书写一个 richtext 字段 metadata 的能力**。

**③ 防 AI 犯错**
一个 AI 照已发布类型写 `richtext` 的 metadata，写不出来；能跑通的唯一路径是 `as unknown as MarkdownFieldMetadata` —— ⭐ **一个类型面上的刻意 cast，基本总是在说「这里少了一个声明」**（本轮同族第二例：#6950 的 `binding` 靠 `as ComponentMeta` 抵达）。

**④ 创业阶段不扩散**
「加」= 新增一个已发布类型面成员（人工地板）；「不加」= 一条别名说明 + 一处注释，普通车道。

**⚠️ 一条不对称，它决定「不加」是否真的更便宜 —— 保留自上一条分诊，仍然成立**
⭐ **「不加」不是「什么都不做」。** 若裁「不加」，那条说明**必须写在 `RichTextField` 服务三个 key 的那处**，并且 `RichTextField.rows.test.tsx:48-50` 的注释与 cast **要就地指向它**——否则下一个人会再发现一次，再开一张卡。（本卡自己就是那次「再发现」。）

**⚠️ 裁「加」时的硬前置**
`MarkdownFieldMetadata` 与 `HtmlFieldMetadata` 现在**都声明了 `rows`**（#6140 的成果）。若加 `RichtextFieldMetadata`，它的读集必须与那两者**逐键核对**。⛔ 不要按「大概一样」写——三个 key 共用一个 widget，恰恰意味着差异只可能藏在细节里。

### 三、定级 p3 / 车道 `domain:spec` 保持

无运行时缺陷、无用户可见错误数据；缺的是可书写性。⇒ p3。
两条方向都改 `packages/types`（加一个 union 成员，或在类型文档里写明别名关系）⇒ `domain:spec`。

⛔ 我不选。⛔ 本 session 是 `claude-opus-5`，`CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 硬闸要求 fable。

## Ruling recorded — add `RichtextFieldMetadata` (director seat, decision batch #71, 2026-09-07)

Maintainer reply, verbatim: 「其他同意」 (this card: adopted as recommended).

**Ruling.** The three registry keys one widget serves (`markdown` / `html` / `richtext`, #5498) each get an exported metadata type. `RichtextFieldMetadata` joins the `FieldMetadata` union in `@object-ui/types`, so an author can write a richtext field's metadata as a typed literal; the deliberate `as unknown as MarkdownFieldMetadata` in `packages/fields/src/widgets/__tests__/RichTextField.rows.test.tsx:50` and its comment at `:48` go. Not the same case as #6950: this is metadata an author legitimately writes, not a framework-injected key.

**Execution notes.** Derive the member's read set key by key from what `RichTextField` actually reads for the `richtext` key and cross-check against `MarkdownFieldMetadata` and `HtmlFieldMetadata` (both declare `rows` since #6140) — do not copy "probably the same". Widening a published type face ⇒ `needs:contract-review`, `@object-ui/types` changeset (minor); pin: a typed `richtext` literal compiles and the widget renders it.

Labels: `needs-user-decision` → `pm:queue`. Ledger on objectstack#12708 (batch #71).

## ✅ ACCEPT — PR #8373, green on every check, parked at the clause-② gate

PM, `domain:spec` @ objectui, session `session_01QtGhnU3WnnWyiWeYQhw2aX`, R3. Verification readings **2026-09-07T16:31–16:34Z**, taken from the API and the tree, ⛔ not from the report.

| claim | my independent reading |
|---|---|
| the dual carrier is satisfied | ✅ PR #8373 labels read at 16:31Z: `['package: types', 'tests', 'needs:contract-review', 'package: fields']`; still on card #7083 |
| CI complete and green | ✅ 32 check runs on `83aa686`, **29 success / 3 skipped / 0 failures** |
| draft, unqueued | ✅ `draft: true` |
| the barrel is in the diff, as declared in advance | ✅ `+1/-0` at `:476` |

---

## ⭐ The carrier write is the vindication of a decision I made under uncertainty, and it is now measurable

At 14:59Z I read PR #8373 with labels requested and got **no labels at all**, while its sibling #8372 carried `needs:contract-review`. I chose **not** to hang it myself, for one reason: the only label write I had available sets the whole array, and this repo's `label` workflow was adding package labels concurrently — a set-write could have stripped what the workflow was about to add.

The readings now close that loop:

- the dev hung it **additively** (`POST /issues/8373/labels`, http 200), read back in the same stroke as `['needs:contract-review']`;
- re-read ~85 minutes later: `['package: types', 'tests', 'needs:contract-review', 'package: fields']` — **the carrier survived and the workflow's three labels arrived alongside it.**

⇒ ⭐ **The race was real, and the additive endpoint is what made both writes survive.** A set-write at 14:59Z would have raced exactly that window. ⛔ Recorded as a mechanism, not as a near-miss anecdote: *a label write on a fresh PR is concurrent with the repo's own labeler, so the endpoint choice is load-bearing, not stylistic.*

## ⭐ `max_length` was decided by measurement, which is precisely what the ruling demanded

The ruling's execution note was explicit: *"Derive the member's read set key by key from what `RichTextField` actually reads … — do not copy 'probably the same'."* The two siblings both declare `max_length`. The derivation found the widget reads it **nowhere** (nor `maxLength`), and that `form.tsx` never sees these three types at all — they route to the registered widget, so its `maxLength ?? max_length` dual-reads never fire for them.

So the sibling-symmetry argument and the read-set argument **disagreed**, and rather than pick one, the dev went to the authority:

> `FieldSchema.safeParse` from the installed `@objectstack/spec` (17.3.0, version read at runtime) over base fixtures for markdown / html / richtext / textarea / text: for all three of markdown, html and richtext the answers are **identical** — control accepted, `rows: 4` accepted, `maxLength: 50` accepted, `max_length: 50` **refused by name** (`unrecognized_keys`). The **`text` control differs** (`rows` refused), proving the instrument discriminates.

⇒ `max_length` is declared, **on that reading** — with a firing control that rules out a vacuous "everything passes". ⭐ And the stated reason is the right one: omitting it would have made `richtext` the one key of the three whose ceiling cannot be authored — *a fresh instance of the asymmetry this card exists to end.*

⭐ The negative half is equally well done and easy to skip: the readonly branch hands `field` **whole** to the cell renderers, so it is the one place the carrier leaves the widget. Both renderers destructure `{ value }` only ⇒ **the display half contributes zero keys.** Checked rather than assumed.

## ⭐ Two gates were red on first run and both were preconditions, not verdicts

`check:readme-exports` (8 unjudged self-imports in two **unbuilt** packages) and `check:doc-snippets` (a `UIMessage` mismatch against a **stale dist**, because sibling PR #8341 landed that README into `main` between this branch's base and the merge). Both re-measured green after the precondition was met, and ⛔ neither was reported at its first exit code.

⚠️ **That is the second instance of this class in one round** — #8127's dev found `check:spec-floors` exits 1 with 18 `[no-artifact]` findings when run before `turbo run build`. ⇒ Naming it, because it cuts both ways: **a gate's first red is not a verdict until its preconditions are met, and a gate's first green is not one either.** A seat that reports the first exit code it sees will publish a false red here and a false green in the mirror case.

⚠️ Also correctly not counted as failures: `check:changeset-presence` and `check:lint-coverage` are not script names in this repo (`ERR_PNPM_NO_SCRIPT`); the real ones are `changeset:check` and `lint:coverage`. ⛔ Those two names came from the dev's own derivation, not from my dispatch's list — and a missing script is a **MODULE_NOT_FOUND**, ⛔ never a red.

## ⭐ A finding that refuted a card I filed today

The dev ran `check-clause2-carriers.mjs` against **objectui** and got a clean per-pair answer — which contradicted **objectstack#16623**, a card *I* filed at 13:31Z claiming that script cannot be pointed at another repo. I re-measured rather than accept either account:

```
node …/check-clause2-carriers.mjs --pair 8373                          → EXIT 2, ⛔ "Not a clearance"
PM_SWEEP_REPO=objectstack-ai/objectui node … --pair 8373               → EXIT 0, correct objectui answer
```

⇒ **My card was wrong and is corrected** (comment 5573481868, title amended). ⚠️ One precision the dev did not have: `PM_SWEEP_REPO` is **not read by that script's own file** — it arrives through an import, and it is a documented `scripts/pm/**` convention (`ci-failure.mjs:214/:346`, `ensure-pm-labels.sh:220`). ⇒ The result was right; the mechanism named was one layer off.

⭐ **The methodological lesson is mine, and it is new:** my card carried a control — "the file is greppable and argv IS parsed" — and that control was **sound and irrelevant**. It ruled out a broken instrument; it said nothing about a **wrongly-scoped query**. I have spent this session insisting a zero needs a live control; this was a zero that *had* one and was still wrong. ⇒ **A control proves the search ran, not that it searched the right place.**

⚠️ Consequence I am recording rather than leaving implied: every claim comment this seat wrote today says `dispatch-gates.mjs` was "NOT recorded as run" because it "lives only in objectstack". If the sweep repo is a parameter, that reasoning is suspect for **both** scripts. ⛔ Not yet measured for `dispatch-gates.mjs`, ⛔ not asserted — it is the next probe, and if it holds, those claims owe a correction.

## The barrel — the advance declaration did exactly its job

`packages/types/src/index.ts` **is** in the diff (`+1/-0` at `:476`), declared in the claim before a line was written. Sibling lane PR **#8360** is live on the same file at `~:1106` (the `Cloud` re-export), ~630 lines away. ⇒ Left to the merge queue: ⛔ no hand-ordering, no rebase-to-suit, no coordination write. ⭐ This is the R1 near-miss surface (#8296 and #8297 both added a barrel line, neither claim declared it) behaving correctly the second time, because the collision was priced in advance instead of discovered.

## Deviations — all accepted

The in-surface docblock re-point at `RichTextField.rows.test.tsx:16-19` (the file's header described the gap too, four lines above where the cast was — required by the ruling's own reason for deleting the comment); the cross-repo carrier-script invocation; the shared verify lock from the objectstack tree with one exit-99 queue-timeout correctly recorded as **NOT MEASURED, not a red**; the `main` merge mid-run; and the resume after the usage wall, with ⛔ **nothing redone** — branch state re-read, CI's own conclusions folded in as authoritative over the local runs.

⚠️ **Non-vacuity of the compile leg is structural, not an ablation**, and the dev said so plainly: on the pre-change tree the annotated literal cannot be written at all. ⭐ It also **measured** that the leg is actually judged — `packages/fields`' default tsc program excludes tests (`--listFiles` → 0 hits) while `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` names both pin files. ⇒ A pin that is not in the compiled program is not a pin, and that was checked rather than assumed.

## ⚠️ One PM ruling, dispatched back to the dev

The dev flagged, correctly and without touching it, that `packages/fields/src/widgets/RichTextField.tsx:283-289` now carries a claim **this PR makes false** — *"the third key, `richtext`, has no union member of its own"* — and left it because that file was READ ONLY in my dispatch.

⇒ **I am widening the surface by that one file for that one correction.** The ruling's stated purpose for deleting the test's comment was that the gap must not stay rediscoverable; the same sentence is now false in the widget, four lines from where the reader looks. Executing the ruling in one file and not the other for a surface-boundary reason is not a reason. ⭐ **A comment made false by this very diff is this diff's to fix**, not a follow-up card's. Sent back with a hard stop-and-report if the correction cannot be made without touching code.

## Route from here

⛔ Nothing lands until a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` reviewer clears both carriers in one stroke. Three of this seat's PRs now sit in that state — **#8354** (#7760), **#8372** (#8127), **#8373** (#7083) — all draft, all green, all with both carriers hung. That is the sanctioned resting state under the maintainer's 「条款② 的 PR 可以等复审」, reported as a queue-shape observation and ⛔ never as a request to lower the bar.

## ✅ Delta ACCEPTed — the prose correction is in at `de98ffd`, and it was proved comment-only rather than asserted

PM, session `session_01QtGhnU3WnnWyiWeYQhw2aX`. Follow-up to the ACCEPT above (5573498618), covering only the surface widening I sent back.

⭐ **The proof is the part worth keeping.** I asked for a prose-only correction; "I only touched comments" is the kind of claim that is easy to make and hard to check, so the dev made it checkable two independent ways:

1. `git diff 83aa686 de98ffd -U0`, changed lines filtered to those that are **not** `//` comments → **0 lines**;
2. both revisions of the file with every comment line stripped **hash identically** — md5 `da2c912555e22ae7d31ddd475cb2dddf` on each side.

⇒ ⭐ The second is the stronger one and is worth stealing: **a same-hash-after-stripping test cannot be satisfied by a change that moved any code**, whereas a filtered diff only shows what the filter admits. Nothing behavioural, no read site, no signature, no import moved.

## ⭐ The stop-and-report branch was correctly NOT taken — and correctly not over-taken either

The honest correction turned out to be reachable without touching code, so the derivation's claim that the widget needs no change **survives**. And the restraint underneath it is the right call:

> The cast at `:290` (`field as MarkdownFieldMetadata | HtmlFieldMetadata`) stays byte-identical and stays **correct**: it never had to discriminate, and every key the widget reads (`rows`, `mobile_fullscreen`, `placeholder`, `label`) is declared on all three members, so the two named already admit every read below. Adding the third member would have been expressively tidier and behaviourally identical — **i.e. a code change with no defect behind it** — so it was NOT made.

⇒ ⛔ Not widening a parked PR for tidiness, on a surface I had just widened by one file. That is the correct reading of what the widening was **for**: the comment was false; the cast was not.

The new text says what is true now — all three keys have an exported type; `richtext` gained `RichtextFieldMetadata` in this card — and keeps the two clauses of the original that remain accurate (the `rows`-since-#6140 ruling, and the `as any` provenance). ⇒ The rediscovery loop is closed in **both** files, which is what the ruling's reason required.

## State after the push

`de98ffd` · **draft** · not enqueued · auto-merge unarmed · labels `['package: types', 'tests', 'needs:contract-review', 'package: fields']` — **unchanged, and no label write of any kind was issued this round**, so nothing could have stripped them. ⛔ Neither carrier cleared. Gate scope held to the three I named (`type-check`, `packages/fields` tests — 138 files / 2352 tests, byte-identical to the pre-correction run, *as a comment-only change must be* — and `check:control-bytes`); the farm was ⛔ not re-run.
